newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment credit line raised.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment credit line raised.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said Tuesday it had received a commitment letter from BankAmerica Corp's Bank of America NW, N.A., dba Seafirst Bank, to increase the amount available under Hollywood's revolving credit line to $150 million.
Hollywood said Bank of America will continue its commitment at $50 million and will syndicate the balance of the increased line on a "best efforts" basis.

The terms of the expanded credit line would be substantially similar to the existing terms, but the company anticipates the applicable interest rate would be higher for all amounts outstanding under the expanded line.

Expansion of the credit line to $150 million is subject to the negotiation and execution of definitive documentation and increased participation of current members of the bank syndicate or further syndication of the loan.
